description: This file contains the 'SubscriptionStatus' model class for an OpenCart extension, responsible for managing subscription status records, including CRUD operations and descriptions, in the database.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription status records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving subscription status data and descriptions.

methods.name: addSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Creates a new subscription status record in the database, handling multiple languages and caching.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing subscription status record, replacing its descriptions and updating cache.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Deletes a specific subscription status record from the database and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all subscription status descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription status record for a given ID and current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscription status records, optionally filtered by language, with pagination and caching.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscription status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a subscription status in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for subscription statuses in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription status description for a given status ID and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given subscription status ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all subscription status descriptions for a specific language.
